A static storefront on Cloudflare Pages loads in under 200 milliseconds anywhere on earth. NOWPayments accepts payment in USDT, Bitcoin, Solana, and 300 plus other coins from any buyer with a wallet — no account creation, no identity verification, no geography check. The webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. The download link arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. This is what sovereign commerce infrastructure looks like operating at full capacity from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, or Harare.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to unlocking your ecommerce potential lies in leveraging blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure. By doing so, you bypass traditional payment gateways and their restrictive policies, ensuring you can sell your ebooks to anyone, anywhere in the world, without intermediaries taking a cut of your hard-earned money. This approach gives you the autonomy to manage your store, process payments, and deliver products directly to your customers, all while maintaining full ownership of your data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. First, ensure you have a clear understanding of your target audience and the ebooks you want to sell. Next, set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your store, and choose a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You'll also need to decide on an order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery method, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your infrastructure components in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves integrating NOWPayments, a crypto payment processing solution, into your store. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and offers a competitive 0.5% fee, making it an attractive option for digital creators. By leveraging NOWPayments, you can automatically verify on-chain crypto payments and deliver ebooks to your customers instantly, eliminating the need for intermediaries and ensuring a seamless transaction experience.
Deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This is a crucial step, as it validates your setup and ensures everything is working as expected. Start by loading your ebooks into your store, configuring your payment and delivery pipeline, and testing your setup to ensure a smooth customer experience. With your store live, you can begin promoting your ebooks to your target audience, confident in the knowledge that your infrastructure can handle transactions efficiently and securely.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store gains traction, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to accommodate growing demand. This involves monitoring your store's performance, optimizing your backend logic, and ensuring your order storage and file delivery solutions can handle increased traffic. By leveraging the scalability of Cloudflare infrastructure and the flexibility of blockchain-based payments, you can confidently expand your store's capabilities, reaching a wider audience and increasing your revenue without worrying about platform restrictions or intermediaries taking a cut of your sales.

To get started with your sovereign commerce infrastructure, focus on setting up a robust payment and delivery pipeline, leveraging solutions like NOWPayments and Cloudflare infrastructure. This will enable you to process transactions efficiently, deliver ebooks instantly, and maintain full ownership of your data, ensuring a seamless and secure customer experience.
Take control of your online store and sales.

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $197, provides you with the necessary tools and guidance to deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, including templates, blueprints, and a scaling playbook, helping you establish a thriving online store and reach a global audience.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up your hosting solution, choose a backend logic solution, configure your order storage and file delivery methods, integrate NOWPayments, load your ebooks into your store, test your setup, and go live. By following these steps, you'll be well on your way to establishing a thriving online store, capable of processing transactions efficiently and securely, and reaching a global audience without platform restrictions.
